description: Axmed | AI Engineer (Agentic Systems) | REMOTE (preferred CET ±2: Spain, UK, Poland, Romania) | Full-time Axmed runs a live B2B marketplace connecting healthcare providers in low- and middle-income countries with pharmaceutical suppliers, working to make sure geography and income never stand between someone and the medicine they need. Backed by the Gates Foundation and Founderful. We're past proving it works and into scaling it — this role is what takes us there. You'll design and ship autonomous agents that run real steps of the marketplace (sourcing, quoting, order matching, supplier follow-up) on real transactions and real money, with a human in the loop only where risk demands it. Not research: you consume LLMs via API and build the judgment, guardrails, and monitoring around them, end to end, and own what you ship. Stack: Python, LangChain/LangGraph/LlamaIndex/CrewAI (your choice), LLM APIs, cloud infra, CI/CD. No visa sponsorship/relocation. Apply: https://axmed.teamtailor.com/jobs/8175859-ai-engineer
all_locations: REMOTE (preferred CET ±2: Spain, UK, Poland, Romania)
